svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.title: textui - workbench
svg.text: every one of them takes keys
a value out of a set
the four tones, and a shape each
Rolls the canaries first and waits for
the error rate to settle before the rest.
a series in one row, or in a block
a value per label, sorted as given
a value per cell, one ramp
rows, with a description and a meta
nested, and open where it is open
error rate flat, check log file to see
a footer too, if you want one
the tone carries it, not the wording
an empty state, and a loading one
Two replicas restarted in the last hour.
headings, emphasis, a rule, a list
the rows an application frames with
